visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens at a street food stall in a bustling outdoor market. A middle-aged woman wearing a floral-patterned black shirt and plastic gloves is seen behind a large, flat circular frying pan. On a bamboo mat in the foreground, several blocks of 'Mao Tofu' (hairy tofu) are arranged, covered in thick, white, mold-like fur. The background is a sunny street with various vendors and pedestrians. (2) The camera zooms in on the raw tofu, showing the delicate white texture of the fur. The woman uses a small knife to cut the blocks, which causes the fur to flatten instantly. She places the tofu pieces into the hot pan filled with oil. (3) The scene shifts to a close-up of the tofu frying in the pan, turning golden brown. The woman uses wooden chopsticks to flip the pieces. (4) In a new phase, the vendor is seen mixing the golden-fried tofu in a metal bowl with green onions and a large amount of red chili powder. (5) A young man with glasses and a black cap is shown in a medium close-up, holding a paper tray filled with the spiced tofu. He uses a bamboo skewer to pick up a piece, brings it to his mouth, and eats it with a surprised and satisfied expression. The background shows signs for other food stalls.

The vendor's female voice replies with a friendly, casual tone. (2) A distinctive sizzling sound of frying oil is heard as the tofu is placed in the pan. (3) A metallic scraping sound occurs as the vendor moves the tofu with a spatula. The male host expresses amazement, his pitch rising as he comments on the texture of the white fur. (4) A short 'pop' sound effect marks a transition to the seasoning stage. The sound of a metal spoon clinking against a bowl is audible. (5) The male host's voice becomes highly energetic and positive, describing the aroma as 'super fragrant'. (6) The sequence concludes with a dialogue between the male and female hosts about the unique 'creamy' and 'stinky' flavor profile, backed by a continuous, cheerful BGM loop.
